**Starting quarterback for the New York Jets in 2015:**  
- **Mark Sanchez**

**Other NFL teams Mark Sanchez played for, and the head coaches who were in charge when he was on those rosters:**

| Team | Years with the team | Head coach(s) during that period |
|------|---------------------|----------------------------------|
| **San Diego / Los Angeles Chargers** | 2018 | **Anthony Lynn** (full season 2018) |
| **Buffalo Bills** | 2019 | **Sean McDermott** (full season 2019) |

*(Sanchez had a brief offseason stint with the Washington Redskins in 2020 but did not play in a regular‑season game.)*
